nodes.title: The L2 break measured on the dry matrix (4 pilots x 4 rule-based children) before any paid run, by changing only the cap. Rows in the four steady lessons / check-ins per steady lesson / turns over 75 words in 16 lessons / turns over 60 words: director25's code 133, 115, 121, 129 / 12 to 14 / 20 / 65; break at 45 words 189, 191, 203, 185 / 54 to 58 (24 to 27 back to back) / 4 / 12; at 60 words 161, 159, 165, 161 / 38 to 43 / 4 / 14; at 75 words 147, 135, 165, 131 / 27 to 33 (7 to 12 back to back) / 5 / 57; as integrated (75 for a turn of parts, 60 for a point with its card, after the merge fix-up) 131, 133, 161, 117 / 24 to 32 (7 to 11 back to back) / 6 / 44. Method: evals/hybrid-side-by-side --dry; a check-in is a turn ending on one of the check-in forms.

A turn of parts breaks at 75 words, not 45; a new point and its card are never one turn of over 60 words (director24's L, kept). From the dry measurement and the director25 judges' own boundary (62 to 70 words read as tutoring, 76 and over as monologue). The wrap's first turn ends on wrap.ask (how the lesson felt), not a comprehension check; a go-on line may lead the aside's return turn. Reverse: a steady lesson over 170 rows in a judged run or two judges finding the check-ins tedious, then the break of turns without a card is dropped (point-and-card split, return turn and two-turn wrap stay); two judges finding 61-to-75-word turns monologue, then the break moves to 60 only where a turn holds a verdict, its why and a new point.

Rejected before release: breaking every turn of parts at 45 words (dc-r8-director25 L2 as first written, from clause 6's pre-set remedy). What broke, on the dry matrix: every steady lesson 185 to 203 rows (the decision's own limit was 170), 54 to 58 check-ins a lesson where there were 13, half of them back to back; a verdict alone with a check-in 22 to 26 times a lesson. A remedy fixed in a clause before a run is still measured before it ships.

H4 (help) and L2 (turn shape) were built by two agents in parallel in the same files; each read 0 on every gated predicate alone and merged with five small textual conflicts. On the merged tree six gated predicates were non-zero (clarifyCard 9, parkReturned 1, returnAlone 3, giveUpCheckin 1, helpRepeats 3, longPointCard 16): four real faults where the two changes met, two rulings needed. Parallel builds in one walk are called done only on the merged dry matrix; the fix-up cost one more agent run.

The session's container restarted twice during the build (2026-11-16 23:43 and 2026-11-17 about 01:00 UTC), stopping every background agent. Agents told to commit each working step lost minutes, not hours; the first launch, three minutes in, lost nothing. Two agent-made copies of the whole tree (900 MB each, for before/after comparisons) took the disk from 5 GB free to 3.6: agents are told to use git show for old code and never copy the tree.

Integration 79 (H4 + L2 + Learning 014, merged and fixed up) on the dry matrix: 68 predicates, every gated one 0; repeatedAuthored (pending) 11. 676 teacher turns in 16 lessons; 44 over 60 words (old baseline 67), 6 over 75 (four wraps' first turns, two help turns); two-part turns over 75 words 0; help turns 188 with 0 saying a sentence from the said set; compile holes on the four pilots 0. Each new predicate reads non-zero on the director25 fixture rows the judges named (tests/r8-director25-help-predicates, tests/r8-director25-l2-predicates). Dry only: a live child and the model's classification are not reached.
